items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Sweets Edison was in the band

ctx.x: Billy Kyle to me was a fantastic piano player. I first heard him with Lucky Millinder; that's when I first knew him. He was in that great band that Lucky had back there in the thirties when he had -- Andy Gibson was in the band, Sweets Edison was in the band, Charlie Shavers.
